decision.explanation: Both the University of Udine (D1S1–D1S18) and Warner Bros. Discovery Nordic (D2S1–D2S16) are directly and explicitly stated as organizations Arianna Barchiesi worked for. D1 provides detailed evidence of her academic and research affiliations with the University of Udine, while D2 describes her role as a researcher within Warner Bros. Discovery Nordic. These are distinct, valid referents supported by their respective documents. Neither is contradicted nor incidentally mentioned.
